thread.title: Dow Jones Cools Off; These Growth Stocks Test Buy Points | Investor's Business Daily

author: DAVID SAITO-CHUNG
title: Dow Jones Cools Off; These Growth Stocks Test Buy Points | Investor's Business Daily
text:
The Dow Jones Industrial Average, feeling the weight of a sharp profit miss by its blue-chip component Caterpillar ( CAT ), got off to a weak start for the week. The Dow Jones fell 0.8%. But during the low point in stocks today, the popular index sank as much as 1.7%.
X Meanwhile, during a session like Monday, traders can expect top-rated growth stocks to cool their heels. And after a recent breakout, some of these potential market leaders may reverse lower and test proper breakout points . PayPal ( PYPL ), Tencent Music Entertainment ( TME ) and Domino's Pizza ( DPZ ) all tested their new buy points.
At the session's low of 24,323, the Dow Jones still held bullishly above its still downward-slanting 50-day moving average.
The stock market flashed an inflection point on Jan. 4. The S&P 500 delivered a seventh-day follow-through . It marked a potential shift in the supply-demand equation for stocks among institutions. Read more about the follow-through concept and the current status of stocks via The Big Picture .
The S&P 500, which gave back a miserly 0.2% last week after four solid up weeks in a row, matched the Dow Jones' 0.8% loss.
Meanwhile, a recent new IPO powered nicely past a proper buy point. Bain Capital Specialty Finance ( BCSF ) ran ahead almost 5% to 19.14, easily surpassing an 18.40 entry in a nine-week cup with handle . Volume surged 84% above its 50-day average level to 599,000 shares.
A good cup with handle forms over a minimum seven weeks. The pattern can also develop for as long as six months or more.
The handle portion of this base represents the final shakeout of disgruntled and uncommitted holders. That clears the decks for a potential big rally as institutional investors suddenly show an appetite for shares.
Bain's 5% buy zone goes up to 19.32. The Boston-based business development giant earned 27 cents a share in 2017. Earnings are seen jumping 426% to $1.42 a share in 2018 and 25% in 2019. It has 51 million shares outstanding. BofA Merrill Lynch acted as the lead investment bank for the Nov. 15 IPO at $20.25 a share.
Keep in mind that Bain Capital has decent average share volume, even though it's less than minimum 400,000 to 500,000 shares you'd prefer to see. The average dollar volume is likely to rise. Yet for now, it's running near a thin $6 million.
This Former Tech Stock Leader Drops Hard Again A sharply downward quarterly sales revision from Nvidia ( NVDA ), a well-known name in the semiconductor sector, intensified selling for the tech-heavy Nasdaq. The composite index slipped 1.1%. Small caps did better. The Russell 2000 fell 0.6%.
Volume edged mildly lower on both main exchanges.
At 7084, the Nasdaq composite still keeps its solid January gain of around 6.8%. During the Jan. 4 follow-through , the Nasdaq finished that bullish session at 6738.
On Monday, construction machinery, computer networking, fabless semiconductor, oilfield services, metal ores, oil drilling and biotech shares performed the worst. All of these industry groups and a few others fell 2% or more for the day.
Watch The Stock Market Leaders PayPal, owner of the popular Venmo peer-to-peer digital payments service, roasted the bears as shares jumped 3.5% last week and advanced for a fifth week in a row. The impressive action by the Leaderboard stock culminated with a breakout past a 92.45 correct buy point , derived by adding a dime to the highest price within its handle on the cup-shaped chart pattern.
PayPal on Friday reached as high as 94.58, good for a new high and still within buy range from the 92.45 breakout point .
On Monday, shares shaved losses to end down 2% at 92.30, just 15 cents below the buy point. Volume came in 19% below the stock's 50-day average. That's desirable, given that on Friday, the breakout day showed turnover jump 29% above average.
Will Tencent Music Outpace Most Chinese ADS Shares In 2019? Meanwhile, Tencent Music rebounded nicely from Friday's intraday low of 14.20 to end the day at 15.08, roughly 1.5% above a narrow IPO base entry at 14.85. Even at the day's low, the loss for new buyers was limited to 4%.
When this happens, watch to see if volume slows down vs. recent up days. Also look for strong bounces off intraday lows or the lowest price within a weekly range. These movements would suggest the pullback is temporary and normal.
PayPal, Tencent Music and Domino's all declined Monday in lower volume vs. Friday's bullish up day. Domino's, the fast-growing pizza, sandwich and salad delivery chain, is now testing institutional demand near a 284.80 proper buy point in a long double-bottom base .
A stock that falls more than 7% to 8% below the proper buy point, however, is not acting right. That action triggers the ultimate defensive sell signal .
Dow Jones Stock Caterpillar Drops Hard Caterpillar, a global leader in construction and earth-moving equipment, dropped more than 9% in triple average volume. Adjusted earnings of $2.55 a share in Q4 2018 missed the consensus forecast by nearly 15%.
Sales rose 11% to $14.34 billion. That was the smallest year-over-year top-line increase in six quarters.
Cat has not made new highs since peaking at 173.24 in mid-January of 2018. So for now, the stock is still in the early stages of forming a new base. At 124.37, Cat currently trades 28% below its 2018 peak.
Notice on a weekly chart how Caterpillar's relative strength line , a measure of a stock's performance vs. the S&P 500, is sinking rapidly and lies well below its highs.
According to IBD Stock Checkup , Cat had shown a decent but not great Relative Strength Rating of 78 on a scale of 1 (terrible) to 99 (terrific). The Relative Strength Rating compares a stock's 12-month price performance with all companies in the IBD database. The best stock market winners tend to already show an RS Rating of 80 or higher before they even break out of good bases and rally to new highs.
Earnings Reports Coming Up Meanwhile, keep an eye out for quarterly results from Dow industrial components Apple ( AAPL ) and Pfizer ( PFE ) plus Biogen ( BIIB ) on Tuesday. Verizon Communications ( VZ ) and Boeing ( BA ) report on Wednesday
Analysts expect Apple to post a 7% rise in earnings for the December-ended fiscal first quarter on a 5% revenue slump to $83.99 billion. In early January, Apple warned of a big cut in its expected quarterly sales, due mainly to its struggles in selling the iPhone in China and India.
Boeing has formed an oddly shaped double bottom with a 373.80 buy point. Wall Street sees earnings edging 5% lower to $4.58 a share in the fourth quarter despite sales going up 6% to $26.87 billion. The aerospace giant is also expected to grow earnings 13% in Q1 and sales 9%.
